name: Aloo Chaat
subtitle: fried potato cubes tossed with chaat masala, tamarind and lemon
prepNotes: The potato must be fried hard enough to develop a crust. Boiled potato tossed in spice is a salad, not a chaat.
Dress it at the last second. Chaat that has sat is limp chaat.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until just tender, cool completely, and cut into 2cm cubes.
steps.tip: Cooled potato fries; hot potato steams and breaks.

steps.text: Fry the cubes in hot oil, in batches, until the outsides are properly crisp and brown, about 6 minutes.
Drain on a rack and let them stop steaming.
Toss while still hot with chaat masala, black salt, roasted cumin, chilli powder and amchur.
Add the tamarind extract, lemon juice, green chilli and coriander, and toss once more.
steps.tip: Once. Over-tossing knocks the crust off.

steps.text: Serve immediately, in a bowl, with a spoon.

storage: Has to be eaten within minutes. There is no way to store dressed chaat.
